items.title: Jacobs Solutions (J) Lands Bigger European Infrastructure Roles In Energy Transition Projects
items.summary: Jacobs Solutions (NYSE:J) has won new roles on major European infrastructure and decarbonization projects in the U.K. and Germany. The business has expanded its partnership with National Grid in the U.K. to support critical power network upgrades tied to the energy transition. Jacobs is extending project management services for thyssenkrupp Steel’s hydrogen based direct reduction plant in Germany, a key decarbonization effort.
